💪 EARN MORE WITH FITCOVER — THE #1 BEAUTY BRAND FOR ACTIVE WOMEN


Fitcover is Australia's leading performance cosmetics brand, engineered for women who sweat, train, and refuse to compromise on looking and feeling their best. Our sweat-proof, long-lasting makeup are uniquely built for our sensitive skin girlies who love the gym, the track, and beyond.


🔥 WHY FITCOVER BEATS THE BIG BRANDS FOR AFFILIATES:

✅ 10% commission per sale — 2x more than Sephora (5%) and 2x more than Ulta Beauty (5%)

✅ 30-day cookie window for maximum earning potential

✅ Auto-approval — get your unique link instantly and start earning today

✅ Promote via affiliate link AND coupon codes for higher conversions

✅ PayPal payouts — fast, reliable, global


🏆 ABOUT OUR BRAND & PRODUCTS:

Fitcover was created for the active woman who wants makeup that keeps up with her lifestyle. Our hero products include our cult-favourite Pressed Bronzers, Self-Tan Mousse, Sweatproof Brow Gel, Fibre Lash Mascara, and full Gym Bag Essentials Kits. We are the brand fitness influencers, personal trainers, athletes, and active lifestyle creators trust — and their audiences convert.


💰 HOW AFFILIATES EARN WITH FITCOVER:

Share your unique affiliate link or coupon code with your audience. Earn 10% on every sale made within the 30-day cookie window. Average order value is strong, meaning real, meaningful earnings per referral. Monthly payouts via PayPal.


📣 WHO CONVERTS BEST:

Fitness influencers, gym & wellness creators, beauty bloggers, Makeup artist, personal trainers, self-tan enthusiasts, lifestyle content creators, and anyone with an active, health-conscious female audience.


🎁 WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT:

Fitcover is not available in mass-market stores — we are an exclusively online DTC brand with a loyal, passionate community. Your audience won't find our products on the shelf at Sephora or Ulta. This exclusivity = stronger conversions and higher loyalty.


Join Fitcover today and earn while you sweat with no regrets!
payout_period: Commissions are paid on the 1st of each month for the previous month's approved referrals. Minimum payout threshold: $20 via PayPal.
term_and_condition:
Fitcover Affiliate Program - Terms and Conditions

By applying to and taking part in the Fitcover affiliate program you agree to the terms below. Please read them carefully. We may update these terms from time to time and will let active affiliates know about any material change.

1. Applying and approval

You must be at least 18 years old to join. Every application is reviewed and Fitcover may approve or decline an application at its discretion. Your affiliate account is personal to you and must not be shared, sold or transferred. Please give accurate details, including a valid ABN where you are registered for one.

2. Commission and tracking

Approved affiliates earn commission at the rate shown in their affiliate dashboard on qualifying orders. Referrals are tracked through your unique affiliate link, which has a 30 day cookie window, or through the coupon code issued to you. Commission is calculated on the product subtotal and excludes shipping, taxes, tips and other fees.

3. Adjustments

Commission is reversed on orders that are cancelled, returned, refunded, charged back or identified as fraudulent, and on orders placed by you or on your behalf. Duplicate, test and internal orders do not earn commission.

4. Payment

Commission is approved once the 30 day return period on the order has passed, and is paid to the payment method saved in your affiliate account. Please keep those details up to date, as we cannot pay commission without them. You are responsible for your own tax obligations on any commission you receive.

5. How you may promote Fitcover

We are happy for you to promote Fitcover through your own website, blog, email list, podcast, social media channels and paid advertising, as long as your promotion is honest, clearly discloses that you earn a commission as required by Australian Consumer Law and advertising standards, and follows the rules in sections 6 to 8.

6. Paid advertising: brand bidding is not allowed

Paid advertising is allowed in this program, with one important exception. You must not bid on or advertise against the Fitcover brand. Specifically:

  • Do not bid on "Fitcover", "Fit cover", "fitcover.com", our product names, or any misspelling, plural, translation or close variation of them as keywords on Google Ads, Microsoft or Bing Ads, Amazon, Meta, TikTok, Pinterest or any other paid search, shopping or marketplace platform.
  • Do not use our brand or product names in ad headlines, descriptions, display paths, sitelinks or any other ad asset.
  • Do not use fitcover.com, or any URL that could be mistaken for ours, as the display or destination URL of a paid ad. Paid traffic must go to your own content or to your affiliate link, and it must be obvious that the page is yours and not an official Fitcover page.
  • Do not run brand plus keyword campaigns such as "Fitcover discount code", "Fitcover coupon" or "Fitcover review" in paid channels.
  • If you use broad match, dynamic search ads, performance max or any automated campaign type, you must add our brand terms as negative keywords so our brand traffic is excluded.
  • Do not present yourself as Fitcover, an official Fitcover store, or Fitcover customer support in any advertising.

Organic content that mentions Fitcover, such as reviews, tutorials, comparisons, social posts and SEO content on your own channels, is welcome and is not affected by this section. If you are not sure whether a campaign is allowed, please ask us before you launch it.

7. Coupon codes and deal sites

You may only share the coupon code we have issued to you. Do not create or advertise codes we have not issued, and do not submit your code to coupon aggregators, cashback sites, deal forums or browser extension networks without our written approval.

8. Conduct that is not allowed

  • Spam of any kind, including unsolicited bulk email or SMS, and posting affiliate links where promotion is not permitted.
  • Cookie stuffing, forced clicks, hidden iframes, adware, toolbars or browser extensions that set tracking without a genuine click.
  • Registering domains, social handles or app names that contain our brand or a close variation of it.
  • Misleading, exaggerated or unsupported claims about our products, including therapeutic or medical claims we have not published.
  • Content that is offensive, discriminatory, sexually explicit, defamatory or unlawful.
  • Altering our logos, photography or copy, or using our brand assets in a way that suggests a partnership beyond your role as an affiliate. Assets we supply may be used as provided.

9. If these terms are breached

Where we believe these terms have been breached we may withhold or reverse the commission on affected orders, pause or close your affiliate account and ask you to remove the activity or content in question. Wherever it is practical to do so we will contact you first, explain what we have found and give you a chance to fix it.

10. Ending your participation

You or Fitcover may end your participation in the program at any time, for any reason, by written notice. Commission properly earned before that date on orders that are not later refunded will still be paid. Once your participation ends you must stop using our brand assets, remove your affiliate links and stop using your coupon code.

11. Your relationship with Fitcover

You take part as an independent contractor. Nothing in these terms creates employment, agency, partnership or a joint venture, and you have no authority to make commitments on behalf of Fitcover. You are responsible for the content you publish and for complying with the laws and platform policies that apply to you. To the extent permitted by law, Fitcover is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from your participation in the program, and our total liability is limited to the commission payable to you. These terms are governed by the laws of Australia.

12. Questions

If anything here is unclear, or you would like approval for a specific campaign, email us at admin@fitcover.com before you begin.
